study_purpose: decide whether long historical data is worth purchasing for the Historical Analog research line; not an alpha approval and not a trading approval

predecessor.modification_policy: V1 rules, results, artifacts, code and documents are not modified by this study
predecessor.inherited_from_v1: noise structure only: per-date IC sd 0.066 and the 1.25x SE inflation from autocorrelation, used for power sizing; no V1 effect size is used in any threshold

units: returns and distances are fractions (0.05 = 5%); volatilities are per-session log-return standard deviations; session offsets are XNYS session-grid indices; feature coordinates are per-date cross-sectional percentile ranks in [0, 1]
change_policy: any edit changes the canonical checksum and makes this a different study; new values go to d_v2a_rules_v2.json with a new declaration

data.plan: Stocks Basic (rolling 2 years, no same-day T bar)
data.source: grouped_daily adjusted=false; read from the Strategy C raw cache read-only
data.reference_snapshots: reference tickers type=CS active=true as of the first XNYS session of each calendar quarter; date D uses the latest snapshot with as_of <= D
data.splits: market-wide /v3/reference/splits records; only execution_date <= t enters F(t)
data.price_basis: P(t) = raw close(t)/F(t), H(t) = raw high(t)/F(t), L(t) = raw low(t)/F(t), O(t) = raw open(t)/F(t); F(t) = product of split_from/split_to of the ticker's splits executed <= t
data.volume_basis: V(t) = raw volume (unadjusted); DV(t) = raw close(t) * raw volume(t)

universe.note: identical values to HISTORICAL_ANALOG_V1; declared here independently
universe.security_type: CS in the snapshot as of D, primary_exchange in allowed_primary_exchanges
universe.adv20_definition: mean(raw close * raw volume) over sessions D-20..D-1
universe.history: a bar on every session D-60..D (61 consecutive session bars)

corporate_action_exclusion.split_window: any split (either direction) with execution_date in (session D-60, D] excludes the ticker-date
corporate_action_exclusion.ca_suspect_window: any P(t)/P(t-1) >= 3.0 or <= 1/3 for t in D-59..D excludes the ticker-date

representation.name: market_structure_state_vector_v1
representation.signal_input: the ten structural coordinates below, each replaced by its per-date cross-sectional percentile rank
representation.raw_shape_policy: V1 path similarity is removed from the primary input; joint path+structure distance is forbidden in this study

features.name: return_60
features.hypothesis: quarterly trend context; the same 20d return means different things in different 60d contexts

features.name: dist_to_20d_high
features.hypothesis: supply is thin near recent highs

features.name: position_in_60d_range
features.hypothesis: position inside the range carries low-side information the high distance does not

features.name: rv_20
features.formula: std_ddof1 of ln(P(t)/P(t-1)) for t in D-19..D
features.hypothesis: volatility regime level; the same price move in a different regime has a different forward distribution

features.name: atr_ratio_20_60
features.formula: ATR_20/ATR_60 where ATR_n = mean TR(t) for t in D-n+1..D and TR(t) = max(H(t)-L(t), abs(H(t)-P(t-1)), abs(L(t)-P(t-1)))
features.hypothesis: volatility clusters; contraction and expansion are different states, and true range carries intraday and gap information close-to-close rv does not

features.name: tr_today_ratio
features.hypothesis: whether D itself is an unusual day; just after a shock is a different state from calm

features.name: rvol_today
features.hypothesis: identical price structure with different participation is a different analog

features.name: dollar_volume_ratio_20_60
features.hypothesis: compression with contracting turnover is supply withdrawal; compression with sustained turnover is distribution

excluded_features.52_week_family: 252-session warmup collapses evaluable dates from 221 to 29
excluded_features.market_relative_strength: under per-date cross-sectional rank scaling, rank(return_h - market_return_h) == rank(return_h) exactly, so the coordinate contributes nothing
excluded_features.beta_adjusted_relative_strength: requires a beta estimation window, a new degree of freedom; recorded as a V2-B candidate only
excluded_features.sector_relative_strength: no point-in-time ticker to sector mapping exists in the store
excluded_features.market_regime: constant across a date's cross-section, so it contributes nothing to cross-sectional rank; used for descriptive stratification only

representation.volume_pit_note: every volume reference window lies inside the (D-60, D] split protection window, so unadjusted raw volume is split-consistent and no V*F transform is declared
representation.post_result_change: adding, removing or redefining any coordinate is forbidden

scaling.formula: (average rank - 1)/(n - 1) over that date's full eligible universe, ties take the average rank
scaling.population: the date's full eligible universe, not the query sample
scaling.declared_cost: rank scaling discards distribution shape; 5x and 3x of a base map to the same value when both sit in the top 1 percent. Accepted knowingly in exchange for PIT safety and zero estimation parameters

similarity.formula: d = ||v_q - v_n||_2 over the ten rank coordinates, ascending
similarity.tie_break: library end session index ascending, then ticker ascending

library.definition: every (ticker, end session d) window that passes the universe rule as of d, has all ten coordinates finite, has a valid label for the tested horizon h, and satisfies the neighbor policies for the query
library.library_stride_rule: library end session index d with d % 5 == 0 on the session grid
library.min_history: same as universe.history (bars on every session d-60..d)

insufficient_neighbors: fewer than top_k neighbors after all policies -> query excluded as INSUFFICIENT_NEIGHBORS, counted
vector_undefined: any non-finite coordinate -> the (ticker, date) window is excluded from both query and library, counted as VECTOR_UNDEFINED

same_symbol_policy.rule: exclude every library window whose ticker equals the query ticker, over the whole history
same_symbol_policy.figi_rule: also exclude a library window whose composite_figi (snapshot as of its end date) equals the query composite_figi (snapshot as of D) when both are non-null
same_symbol_policy.ticker_reuse_handling: a different company that reuses the query ticker is also excluded (conservative); a renamed company without a composite_figi match is not detected (known limitation)

embargo_policy.forward_label_embargo: neighbor label window d+1..d+h must end on or before D (d + h <= D)
embargo_policy.overlapping_window_rule: neighbor span d-L..d+h must end before the query coordinate window starts: d + h <= D - L
embargo_policy.effective_rule: d + h <= D - 60 (strict; implies the forward-label embargo)
embargo_policy.reason: a neighbor whose coordinate window or outcome overlaps the query coordinate window measures contemporaneous co-movement, not a historical analog

neighbor_concentration_policy.selection: greedy in similarity order, skipping a candidate that would break either cap, until top_k are accepted

labels.window: sessions D+1..D+h; D itself never included
labels.excess_return_h: close_return_h minus the median close_return_h over all label-valid eligible tickers of the same date (full universe, not the query sample)
labels.validity: a bar on D+1 (else NO_ENTRY_BAR), a bar on session D+h itself (else MISSING_HORIZON_BAR), not label CA suspect
labels.label_ca_suspect: V1 rule as is for h <= 10; for h = 20 the same ratio rule extended over D+11..D+20
labels.applies_to: query evaluation labels and neighbor labels (same definitions)

horizons.primary_justification: the coordinates are defined on 20 and 60 session windows; a state read at D stays the same state only while a fraction of its defining window is intact, so h=5 (25 percent of the shortest window) matches the state's own horizon better than h=10 (50 percent). Secondary reasons: the swing slot between B (no overnight) and E0 (overnight), and half the label overlap of h=10 across consecutive evaluation dates. V1 horizon results are explicitly not part of this justification
horizons.secondary_role: descriptive only, never a gate input

signal.primary: median of the accepted top_k neighbors' excess_return_5
signal.direction: higher A(q) predicts higher query excess_return_5
signal.mean_variant: reported as secondary; never substituted for the median

baseline_B0.name: equal_weight_signed_rank_composite
baseline_B0.formula: B0(q) = (1/10) * sum_i s_i * r_i(q), r_i = the coordinate's per-date percentile rank
baseline_B0.wrong_sign_risk: four signs carry weak priors; a wrong sign lowers B0's IC and would inflate the primary delta. Controlled by gate condition S4 (sign guard) and by mandatory secondary S-6 (per-coordinate univariate IC)
baseline_B0.pit: computed from the query's own coordinates only; reads no label, no neighbor and no realized return

baselines_secondary.B1_random_analog: V1 N1: same library, realized-volatility quintile matching, 20 replicates, seed 20260917, draw contract d-n1-draw-v1-prefix-seeded (declared deviation inherited from V1 D4)
baselines_secondary.B2_simple_factor_knn: V1 N2a: the five V1 price features, same library and policies
baselines_secondary.B3_orthogonalized: per date, OLS of rank(A(q)) on the ten standardized coordinates plus intercept; Spearman IC of the residual
baselines_secondary.role: descriptive only; none of these is a gate input
baselines_secondary.b1_demotion_reason: measured in V1: the per-date ICs of the analog and of the random analog are nearly uncorrelated, so sd(IC - IC_N1) exceeded sd(IC) in 13 of 14 tests (median ratio 1.08). Pairing against B1 adds variance instead of removing it. This is a variance-structure argument, not a relaxation

evaluation.session_grid: all usable sessions of the frozen raw cache, index 0..500
evaluation.query_dates: every session index in [260, 480], common to the primary test, every secondary horizon and every baseline
evaluation.query_sampling: eligible tickers of D ordered by sha256('Q|20260917|{D}|{ticker}'), first 300; sampled before label validity is known; invalid labels dropped afterwards and counted
evaluation.query_seed_reuse_reason: keeping V1's sampling seed prevents sample shopping and keeps the two studies on the same query set
evaluation.ic: Spearman rank correlation between the signal and excess_return_5 over the date's valid queries
evaluation.time_block_rule: evaluable query dates split into 4 consecutive blocks of (near) equal count

statistics.primary_metric: mean over evaluable dates of delta(t) = IC_A(t) - IC_B0(t), both Spearman against excess_return_5 on the same query set
statistics.family_wise: no Bonferroni correction: the primary family has exactly one test, so FWER is 0.05 as declared
statistics.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap over evaluable query dates, block length 20 sessions, 10000 replicates, seed 20260920
statistics.paired: delta uses per-date paired differences under the same bootstrap draws
mandatory_disclosure: an explicit statement when sd(delta) > sd(IC_A), i.e. pairing failed to reduce variance
realized SE against the SE predicted in the contract
statistics.disclosure_effect_on_verdict: none; the gate thresholds do not depend on the realized correlation

power.inputs: per-date IC sd 0.066 and SE inflation 1.25 (both measured in V1 D4); no V1 effect size is used
power.interpretation: the screening can detect only a substantial analog advantage; a small but real advantage lands in BORDERLINE or FAIL, which limits what a FAIL closes
power.approximate_operating_characteristics: under the stated normal approximation, P(PASS | true delta = 0) is about 0.06 to 0.10 and P(PASS or BORDERLINE | true delta = 0) is about 0.16 to 0.22; P(PASS or BORDERLINE | true delta = 0.008) is about 0.72 to 0.97

data_sufficiency.lookback_budget_note: the current store supports a maximum coordinate lookback of about 130 sessions before evaluable dates fall below 150; V2-A uses 60
do_not_start_conditions: any coordinate requiring a volume reference outside the (D-60, D] protection window

conditions.S1_sample: evaluable dates >= 150, valid queries >= 20000, unique query tickers >= 1000, INSUFFICIENT_NEIGHBORS share <= 0.05, VECTOR_UNDEFINED share <= 0.05
conditions.S6_delta_ci_low: 95 percent percentile CI lower bound of mean delta > -0.0025
conditions.S7_block_stability: delta > 0 in >= 3 of 4 chronological blocks AND IC(A) > 0 in >= 3 of 4 blocks
conditions.S8_quintile_spread: Q5 - Q1 mean realized excess_return_5 by A(q) quintile > 0

pass_fail_policy.threshold_justification: S5 and S6 were set from V1's measured noise (per-date IC sd and SE inflation) to hit declared operating characteristics: P(PASS | no advantage) <= about 0.10 and P(PASS or BORDERLINE | advantage 0.008) >= about 0.70. No V1 effect size entered the numbers

decision.SCREENING_BORDERLINE: S1, S2, S3, S4 and S8 hold, mean delta > 0, and exactly one of S5, S6, S7 fails

pass_fail_policy.negative_direction: a significantly negative mean IC(A) or mean delta is reported as INVERSE_EFFECT and is never a PASS; using it needs a new declared version
pass_fail_policy.secondary_cannot_overturn: no secondary diagnostic can change the verdict in either direction
pass_fail_policy.on_PASS: LONG_DATA_PURCHASE_CANDIDATE = YES; no backtester, no adapter, no trading spec
pass_fail_policy.on_BORDERLINE: LONG_DATA_PURCHASE_CANDIDATE = YES (conditional); a written cost, effect size and required-sample re-evaluation note is required before any purchase
pass_fail_policy.on_FAIL: Strategy D research CLOSED; long data purchase is not justified by D. The closure is scoped to this coordinate system, this metric, K=50 and this data window
pass_fail_policy.pass_meaning: the structure analog carries information beyond an equal-weight composite of the same coordinates in this two-year window; it is not evidence of alpha and not evidence of a profitable strategy

secondary_diagnostics.role: descriptive only, reported in full regardless of sign, never a gate input
slots: S-6 univariate cross-sectional IC of each of the ten coordinates
S-7 delta against B0-strong (the six STRONG-prior coordinates)
S-8 leave-one-family-out ablation (trend, position, volatility, volume)
S-9 delta against B1 random analog
S-10 delta against B2 five-feature kNN
S-12 IC by mean neighbor distance quintile; realized MFE/MAE by A(q) quintile
S-13 stratification: rv_20 quintile, four time blocks, market rolling volatility terciles, and the within-date Spearman between A(q) and V1's S(q) (W60_H10_B artifact)
secondary_diagnostics.regime_policy: market regime is never a filter in this study; the evaluation window is effectively a single regime (four blocks all positive, annualized volatility 11.6 to 15.5 percent), so regime hypotheses are untestable here and the results must say so

deltas: P-1 signal input is the ten structural coordinates instead of the close path; all use information at or before D
P-2 the embargo constant W is replaced by the coordinate lookback L = 60: d + h <= D - 60
P-3 coordinate standardization uses date D's eligible cross-section only; no future dates and no rolling estimation window
P-4 volume coordinates reference only (D-60, D], inside the split protection window, so no V*F transform is declared
additional: B0 is computed from the query's own coordinates; it reads no label and no neighbor
delta(t) is computed on one date's single query set
a single PIT violation fails S2 and the verdict is FAIL without examining other conditions

data_status_policy.reason: D V1 read this window once, C-4 read it once, V2-A is the third pass
data_status_policy.never: promoted to holdout or locked OOS in any later study
data_status_policy.future_structure: DEV (unused past) -> VALIDATION (limited research choices) -> LOCKED OOS (opened once), physically separated after long data is acquired

checksum_recipe: sha256 of json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded UTF-8, i.e. app.backtest.strategy_c_selection.rules.canonical_checksum; recorded in d_v2a_rules_v1.sha256
